title: Faithful Forever
story:
A grandmother once kept an old letter safely in a wooden box.

Her grandson found it one day.

The paper was yellow with age.

But the writing was still clear.

It was a promise from her husband many years ago.

“I will always take care of you and our family.”

The grandson asked,

“Does this promise still matter after so many years?”

The grandmother smiled.

She said,

“Some promises fade with time.”

“But some promises are kept for a lifetime.”

“Your grandfather lived by this promise until his last day.”

In life, many promises are broken.

People change.

Situations change.

Words are forgotten.

But God is not like man.

His promises do not fade.

His love continues through generations.

What He says, He fulfills.

Always.
life_lesson:
God is completely faithful to His promises.

You can trust Him for every generation of your life.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your unfailing faithfulness.

Your promises never change or fail.

Help me to trust You even when I don’t see immediate answers.

Teach me to rest in Your covenant love.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you find it hard to trust promises because of past disappointments?

How does God’s faithfulness give you confidence today?

What promise of God do you need to hold on to right now?
verse:
Know therefore that the Lord your God is God.
He is the faithful God, keeping His covenant of love to a thousand generations.
